description: The line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of different model variants on three evaluation metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—measured as percentages. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," presents five distinct configurations: "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)," ranges from 58 to 66, with gridlines at every 2 percentage points. The legend indicates that the purple line with circular markers represents Precision, the blue line with circular markers represents Recall, and the brown line with circular markers represents F1-score. The "Full model (Ours)" variant achieves the highest scores for all three metrics, with Precision at 65.45%, Recall at 65.78%, and F1-score at 65.49%. For the "w/o Prompt" variant, the scores are 61.06% for Precision, 59.64% for Recall, and 60.16% for F1-score. The "w/o Augmentation" variant shows a peak in Recall at 62.63%, with Precision at 62.22% and F1-score at 63.75%. The "w/o Attention" variant has a Precision of 64.06%, Recall of 59.17%, and F1-score of 59.67%. The "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" variant shows the lowest scores, with Precision at 65.44%, Recall at 56.82%, and F1-score at 57.74%. The plot demonstrates that the full model performs best, and the removal of components generally leads to a decline in performance, with the most significant drop observed in Recall when both prompt and augmentation are removed.
